title: Mount a USB drive or device using udiskie
summary: Use udiskie-mount to manually mount a specific storage device, such as a USB stick or external hard drive, if it hasn't mounted automatically. You can also mount all connected devices at once.
prerequisites: The device is connected to the computer

steps.explain: Mount a specific device by providing its path (e.g., /dev/sdb1). You can find the device path using `lsblk` or `udisksctl status`.

placeholders.name: DEVICE
placeholders.description: The path to the block device you want to mount, e.g., /dev/sdb1

alternatives.explain: Mount all currently connected and handleable devices at once.
